mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_PWD FROM TB_MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_MEMBER SET STATUS_CD = 'WITHDRAWN' WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_MEMBER_WITHDRAW ( MEMBER_NO, MEMBER_ID, MEMBER_NAME, EMAIL ) SELECT MEMBER_NO, MEMBER_ID, MEMBER_NAME, EMAIL FROM TB_MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}
mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, MEMBER_ID AS memberId, MEMBER_NAME AS memberName, EMAIL AS email, PHONE AS phone, ZIP_CODE AS zipcode, ADDR1 AS addr1, ADDR2 AS addr2, TO_CHAR(BIRTH_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS birthDate, GENDER AS gender, PROFILE_IMG_URL AS profileImgUrl FROM TB_MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}
SELECT MEMBER_NO FROM TB_MEMBER_WITHDRAW WHERE WITHDRAW_DATE IS NOT NULL AND WITHDRAW_DATE <= SYSDATE - 7
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_MEMBER SET MEMBER_ID = MEMBER_NO, MEMBER_PWD = NULL, MEMBER_NAME = '탈퇴회원', NICKNAME = '탈퇴회원', EMAIL = '탈퇴회원', PHONE = NULL, ZIP_CODE = NULL, ADDR1 = NULL, ADDR2 = NULL WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}
